title: A tetranuclear Dy(III) compound with in situ oxazolidine ligand derived from hydroxyquinoline carboxaldehyde: Synthesis, structure, and SMM behavior

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear Dy4 cluster with in situ oxazolidine ligand

synthesis.procedure: HL1 (0.2 mmol), H3L2 (0.2 mmol) and Dy(CH3COO)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol) were placed in a 15 mL Teflon reactor with 10 mL mixed solvent CH3OH:CH3CH2OH = 1:1. The mixture was stirred for 10 min to dissolve, then heated at 60 °C for 36 h and cooled to room temperature at 10 °C/h. Yellow rodlike crystals of 1 were obtained. Ligand HL3 formed in situ by Dy(III)-catalyzed Schiff-base cyclisation of HL1 and H3L2.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow rodlike crystals deposited after cooling

properties.summary: Complex 1 is an SMM under zero dc field. χMT at 300 K is 55.75 cm3 K mol−1 (slightly below 56.68 cm3 K mol−1 for four Dy(III) ions) and falls to 37.63 cm3 K mol−1 at low T. Non-superimposable M vs H/T plots indicate magnetic anisotropy. Frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility is observed at 0 Oe; Cole–Cole data fit a single Debye process (α = 0.02–0.21). Arrhenius analysis gives Ueff = 37.3(2) K and τ0 = 1.3(2)×10−5 s.
